subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------T.C.IMP.------INF.AFB.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 368 (R(AS)CM(II)-12). MT-INFO (multi-information) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the partner. The title names INF-AFB; the chart has no label for it. From T-C-IMP: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis), PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) and TH-CONT-DYM (thrust continuance dynamics). EXT-DYM (extended dynamics) is on a dotted line from T-C-IMP.
